summary: Reconstructed the imapclient 3.0.1 package under imapclient/ from the skeleton: restored the missing helpers (util, version, datetime, IMAP UTF-7, lexer and parser, FETCH/SEARCH/LIST parsing) and the full IMAPClient method set (folders, SELECT/STATUS, IDLE, search/sort/thread, fetch/store and Gmail labels, append/multiappend, ACL, quota, the raw command layer with literal handling), plus TLS/timeout transports, the test double, and config/interact. The last full-suite run was 267 passed, 0 failed.
